points.point: Reconnect button does nothing after clicking it
Starter plan with 20 accounts shown in Accounts

verdict.reason: The customer already clicked Reconnect and it still does nothing, which is a still-failing-after-trying case, and no candidate explains why the button is unresponsive; the reconnect entry's incognito workaround is only a fallback and the 20-account limit entry does not address Reconnect.
